notes.title: A Sincere Thank You and about the Bug Reports
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone ! 

First of all, we want to say we are blown away by the number of people that have engaged with Whispers of the Village. We published the game thinking not many more people than our friends would play it, so needless to say, every download and review has been incredibly rewarding and humbling to us. 

We are aware that some people encountered issues when trying to play the game, most notably the inability to click on some parts of the screen. We're truly sorry about that, and it pains us that the game has been unplayable for some. The truth is, as a team of students, once Whispers of the Village was published, our time and attention have shifted to our next school projects (and much needed vacations). 

We do want to look into these problems, though ! We will try asking for help in solving them, as, to be completely honest, we haven't managed to recreate these bugs ourselves. It would seem the issues come from windowed mode and / or screen resolution, but we can't be too affirmative about that either. We hope we'll be able to fix everything, but at the current time, it's quite hard to say when and if that will happen. We enter our final year of studies and start our most ambitious project yet, all working in different teams this time. 

So once again, thank you so much for showing interest in Whispers of the Village ! We are still very proud of the game and so happy with how it turned out, thanks to you all. We will update you again if anything happens ! 

On that note, we wish you a good day, and many relaxing cups of tea.[/p]
